source_name: SEC Express System — company documents (GIS / AFS / Articles)
rate_limits: per-document order + delivery fee (PHP); no open bulk/API
notes: Official route to SEC company documents: General Information Sheet (GIS — directors/officers/stockholders/capital), Audited Financial Statements (AFS), Articles of Incorporation, certificates. Paid per document (PHP) for delivery. Companies file via eFAST (efast.sec.gov.ph, login). No open bulk/API; sec.gov.ph WAF-blocked. Directors/officers/stockholders = personal data (Data Privacy Act 2012). Field list from public product descriptions; no values copied.

OPEN listed-company source. POST /companyDirectory/search.ax returns name, stock symbol, sector, subsector, listing date; per-company disclosures + financial reports. Verified live: PLDT Inc. (TEL, Services/Telecommunications, listed 1953-09-17), banks, Jollibee (Industrial/Food). Listed companies only (~280). Complements paid SEC documents.

source_name: DTI BNRS — Business Name Registration (sole proprietors)
rate_limits: free business-name search/verification; no open bulk
notes: DTI Business Name Registration System for SOLE PROPRIETORSHIPS (not corporations — those are SEC). Free public business-name search/verification (existence + scope). Issues the DTI BN number. No open bulk.

Relaunched national open-data portal, now a JS SPA (Angular). Landing page has no static catalogue and standard CKAN API paths returned the SPA shell (not JSON). No accessible company-register dataset confirmed headless.
